evidence: This driver only READS duckdb_error_data (from duckdb_expression_fold and the appender/prepare/pending error paths, via the ErrorData RAII reader); it never CONSTRUCTS one, building a pure-Rust EngineError instead. Retained as a documented safe alternative.

Superseded by duckdb_create_varchar_length: the NUL-terminated constructor silently truncates strings at an interior NUL, so String::to_duck uses the length-aware variant instead. Retained as a documented safe alternative, not called from production.

The length-aware duckdb_vector_assign_string_element_len is the sole string-write path (preserves interior NULs and exact lengths); the NUL-terminated duckdb_vector_assign_string_element truncates at an interior NUL, so it is retained as a documented safe alternative rather than exposed as a truncation-prone public write.

Scalar bind data is stored as an owned Box with a destroy callback (duckdb_scalar_function_set_bind_data) and is read-only/shared per the C-API contract, so DuckDB shares the pointer and no deep-copy callback is needed. Retained as a documented safe alternative.
